title: [Master] - Slice 626127: [Excise Tax][VENDOR] Multiple Excise Taxes per Item
summary: Excise tax configuration moved from item fields to a dedicated table to support multiple excise tax types per item, with new list and API pages, upgraded journal generation logic, and deprecated legacy fields.
key_points: New Item Excise Tax table (7415) stores multiple tax types per item, keyed on Item No. + Excise Tax Type Code
Item Excise Taxes list page (7416), opened from the Item Card with a Copy from Item action, plus an Item Excise Tax API page (7417)
Excise journal generation iterates the new table with per-tax-type checks; the ILE Excise Tax Posted flag is set only once all applicable tax types are posted
New OnBefore/OnAfter insert integration events added to journal generation
Legacy Item excise fields marked obsolete (Pending, tag 29.0) and existing data migrated by the Excise Tax Upgrade codeunit
